title: SkyWater sky130A open PDK (prerun; ROM densities not calibrated)
source: sky130A in the pinned iic-osic-tools image; cell areas measured from its liberty files on 2026-10-25; every other value is empirical

prerunConstraint.note: Placeholder prerun die for a slice; no owner decision has set it (the GF180MCU prerun die is 1.2 x 2 mm).

ioRingWidthMm.source: sky130_fd_io pads with the standard edge spacing; to be measured on a real pad ring

macAreaUm2.source: 8x4-bit MAC with a 20-bit accumulator, scaled from GF180MCU by the cell-area ratio (sky130 flip-flop 20.0 um2, GF180 63.7 um2)

flopBitAreaUm2.source: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1 area 20.0192 um2 (Liberty ff_100C_1v65, measured 2026-10-25); typ/high add enable and read multiplexing

controlAreaMm2.source: sequencer, interfaces, debug readback; scaled from GF180MCU

utilization.source: typical standard-cell placement density; to be measured

powerOverhead.source: power grid share of the core area, as in the GF180MCU profile

technology.source: sky130A in the pinned iic-osic-tools image

calibration: not run: the ROM and SRAM densities of library-130nm are empirical (FR-EST-13)
